_readme: external: entered from OUTSIDE the app. Legitimate forever. State how.
debt: known dead ends nobody has wired or deleted. Every entry is a bug
with a URL. Printed on every run so it cannot be forgotten the way
/notebook was (68 days unreachable, zero rows, deleted 2026-09-12).
Adding to debt is not a fix. It is a receipt that says we know.
A retired URL kept alive as a redirect needs NO entry here — the guard
detects a forwarding shim and reports it as a forward, not a dead end.
Keep the redirect: old links live in emails, screenshots and bookmarks,
and a 404 is a worse answer than a forward.

external./: Public landing page — the front door.
external./admin/growth: Admin only, entered by URL by the team.
external./offline: PWA offline fallback, served by the service worker.
external./signup/institutions: B2B campaign landing — entered from outreach, not from the app.
external./dev/phone: 375px device lab (BACKLOG #42). Entered by URL during mobile QA.
external./auth/callback: OAuth redirect target — entered by the identity provider.
external./connect/[partner]: Partner SSO entry — entered from the partner's product.
external./extension/connect: Chrome extension auth handshake — entered by the extension.
external./login: Entered from the public nav and from every auth redirect.
external./signup: Entered from the public nav and from campaigns.
external./onboarding: Entered by redirect after signup — the one door into the spine.
external./onboarding/result: Terminal step of /onboarding, entered by its own flow.
external./cv-preview: Anonymous CV preview — entered from the public scorer.

debt./beta-feedback: Cohort research form, one submission per account, 114 rows, last 2026-07-21. Superseded for general feedback by the always-mounted FeedbackHub. Awaiting Shivam: delete, or re-open for a second cohort and give it a door.
